summary: Preserve capturePage stayHidden/stayAwake visibility and power behavior.

target.notes: Preserve Electron WebContents/Chromium renderer semantics through the ElectronCompat host boundary; do not replace navigation, rendering, printing, or DevTools with ordinary .NET calls.

semantics.stayHidden: keeps hidden page hidden instead of making it considered visible
semantics.capturer_count: default capture contributes to page being considered visible while capturer count nonzero

tests.name: stay hidden
tests.expected_behavior: capture does not force hidden page into visible state for capture policy

tests.name: stay awake
tests.expected_behavior: host power policy keeps system awake for capture
